ubuntu-ext-name: Display name of the extension, shown on Special:Version.
ubuntu-manage-trackers-button-label: Label for the footer link that reopens the cookie consent banner. Shown in the page footer and as a button inside the banner itself.
ubuntu-codeblock-copy:
Generic label for a button that copies content to the clipboard.
{{Identical|Copy}}
ubuntu-codeblock-copied: Generic label shown briefly after content has been copied to the clipboard.
ubuntu-codeblock-copy-captcha-command: Accessible label for a copy button inside a CAPTCHA code block that copies a terminal command to the clipboard.
ubuntu-footer-legal-desc: Label for the footer link whose target is configured as 'legal' in $wgUbuntuFooterLinks. Typically points to legal information about the site.
ubuntu-footer-privacy-desc: Label for the footer link whose target is configured as 'privacy' in $wgUbuntuFooterLinks. Typically points to the site's data privacy policy.
ubuntu-footer-codeofconduct-desc: Label for the footer link whose target is configured as 'codeofconduct' in $wgUbuntuFooterLinks. Typically points to the community code of conduct.
